description.zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1。
description.en:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
可信服务的标识。

具体信息，请参见[支持的可信服务](~~208133~~)中的`可信服务标识`列。
description.en:
The identifier of the trusted service.

For more information, see the `Trusted service identifier` column in [Supported trusted services](~~208133~~).

title.zh: 查询可信服务的委派管理员账号

descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to query all delegated administrator accounts in a resource directory. The response shows that two delegated administrator accounts for Cloud Firewall exist in the resource directory.
